summary: A reading of the Proud Boys' internal manual for running meetings and initiating members, released as evidence in the 2023 seditious conspiracy trial of the US far-right group's leaders over January 6.

evidence.note: Manual entered into evidence via discovery in the sedition case against Proud Boys leaders
Meeting opens with a Pat Buchanan passage minimising slavery and segregation
Degrees of membership: women excluded, trans men barred, beating ritual described
Masturbation rules and housewife veneration read and mocked
Founder Gavin McInnes's ten-point list to save America read at length
Manual cites a member in the White House, dating the text to around 2017
Aftermath of January 6: members panic over arrests and turn on each other

notes: Manual's author is not named; the Proud Boys organization is treated as its author, so no person primary and roles are empty. Manual date estimated at about 2017 from internal references; covered_span starts at the group's 2016 founding. Guilty verdicts (2023) and the group's ongoing activity set reaches_present. hate-speech warning for extended reading of chauvinist propaganda and a slur lookup.
